name: timeknit
description: Show knitr chunk execution times recorded by the timeknit R package inline in Quarto and R Markdown documents

timeknit.enabled.description: Show chunk timings inline after each chunk's opening fence.

enumDescriptions: Right-aligned so that every annotation ends at one column (see timeknit.column)
timeknit.position.description: Where the timing is placed on the chunk's opening line.

timeknit.column.description: Column at which timings end when timeknit.position is "column". 0 uses the first editor.rulers entry, or 80 when there are no rulers.

enumDescriptions: Label in front of the timing on the chunk's opening line
Label on the chunk's opening line and the timing on the line below
timeknit.showLabel.description: Whether and how to show the chunk label next to the timing, in the same style.

timeknit.fontSize.patternErrorMessage: Use a CSS length such as 12px, 0.85em, or 90%, or leave empty.
timeknit.fontSize.description: Font size of the timing annotation, as a CSS length such as "12px" or "0.85em" (relative to the editor font size). Empty uses the editor font size. The text is scaled visually, so column alignment is unaffected.

timeknit.rulerMinOpacity.description: Opacity of the scrollbar (overview ruler) mark for the fastest chunks. Marks fade between this and timeknit.rulerMaxOpacity with the chunk's weight in the chosen color mode.

timeknit.rulerMaxOpacity.description: Opacity of the scrollbar (overview ruler) mark for the slowest chunks.

timeknit.rscriptPath.description: Rscript used by "timeknit: Check Setup". Empty tries Positron's R, the R extension's r.rpath setting, R_HOME, then Rscript on the PATH.

enumDescriptions: Share of the document's total chunk time, on a log scale from 0.5% (green) to 50% (red)
Rank among the document's chunks, from the fastest (green) to the slowest (red)
Absolute duration, on a log scale from 10 ms (green) to 10 s (red)
timeknit.colorBy.description: What the color of a chunk's time and scrollbar mark reflects.
